title: Pure Supreme King
summary: Pure Supreme King Pendulum build centered on calling forth Supreme King Z-ARC alongside the four legendary Dimension Dragons, avoiding outside Magician or Predaplant engines. The deck navigates Supreme King Gate Magician and Soul of the Supreme Celestial King to cheat out a fully-powered board-wiping Z-ARC during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm searches a Supreme King Gate Pendulum Monster on Normal or Special Summon, and Special Summons itself from the GY while you control no monsters.
Supreme King Gate Magician sends a card from hand to GY to place a Supreme King Gate in the Pendulum Zone and Special Summon itself, then searches any card that mentions Supreme King Z-ARC on summon.
Wings of Light is a Quick-Play Spell that adds a Supreme King Dragon or Supreme King Gate Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand, or Special Summons it if you control Supreme King Z-ARC.
Supreme King Dragon Lightwurm adds a face-up Supreme King Dragon or Gate Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to hand on summon, and performs Synchro or Xyz Summons on summon.

summary.title: Opening: Darkwurm + Wings of Light
steps: Activate Wings of Light to search Supreme King Gate Magician from your Deck.
Normal Summon Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm and activate its effect to search Supreme King Gate Zero.
Special Summon Supreme King Gate Magician from your hand by sending Gate Zero to the Pendulum Zone.
Trigger Gate Magician's on-summon effect to search Soul of the Supreme Celestial King from your Deck.
Set Soul of the Supreme Celestial King to prepare the opponent's turn summon of Supreme King Z-ARC.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Supreme King Z-ARC destroys all cards your opponent controls upon Special Summon, cannot be targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects, and prevents the opponent from activating Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Monster effects while in the Pendulum Zone.

Soul of the Supreme Celestial King tributes a Spellcaster monster as a Quick Effect to Fusion Summon Supreme King Z-ARC by banishing the 4 Dimension Dragons from Deck, Extra Deck, and field, retaining Z-ARC's effects.

Supreme King Z-ARC - Synchro Universe treats its name as Supreme King Z-ARC on field and in GY, and Special Summons up to 2 Supreme King Dragon monsters from your Extra Deck and GY after destroying an opponent's monster.

Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon returns an opponent's face-up Attack Position monster to the hand on summon, and shuffles a face-up Pendulum from Extra Deck into the Deck to negate an activated Spell, Trap, or monster effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Soul of the Supreme King pays half your LP to Special Summon Supreme King Z-ARC with negated effects, and banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon the four Dimension Dragons.
Supreme King Gate Zero and Supreme King Gate Infinity provide complete Scale 0 to 13 coverage, enabling Pendulum Summons of any Level.
Miracle of the Supreme King targets Supreme King Z-ARC to negate an opponent's card effect and destroy it, or Sets a Pendulum Monster from Deck to the Pendulum Zone.
Supreme Rage destroys all monsters you control to Special Summon up to 4 Supreme King Dragon monsters with different names from your hand, Deck, Extra Deck, and GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Supreme King Dragon Starving Venom is Forbidden in the TCG, while Starving Venom Wing Dragon and outside Predaplant engines are omitted to maintain pure Supreme King identity.

allow.Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon: The Pendulum Dragon that Soul of the Supreme Celestial King banishes so Z-ARC keeps its effects.
allow.Clear Wing Synchro Dragon: The Synchro Dragon that Soul of the Supreme Celestial King banishes so Z-ARC keeps its effects.
allow.Starving Venom Fusion Dragon: The Fusion Dragon that Soul of the Supreme Celestial King banishes so Z-ARC keeps its effects.
allow.Exceed the Pendulum: Link-3 Pendulum boss providing essential recursion and Special Summoning from hand or GY.
allow.Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon: Dragon Fusion boss providing bounce removal and omni-negation by shuffling face-up Pendulums.

main: Supreme King Dragon Darkwurm
Starter: searches a Supreme King Gate; revives itself onto an empty board.
Supreme King Gate Magician
Summons itself and searches a card that mentions Z-ARC; the Spellcaster Soul of the Supreme Celestial King tributes.
Supreme King Dragon Lightwurm
Tuner: recovers a Supreme King Pendulum from the Extra Deck and Synchro or Xyz Summons.
Supreme King Gate Zero
Scale 0: summons a Fusion or Synchro Dragon from the Extra Deck; searches a Fusion Spell.
Supreme King Gate Infinity
Scale 13: summons an Xyz or Pendulum Dragon from the Extra Deck.
Supreme King Dragon Odd-Eyes
Tributes two Supreme King Dragons to summon itself; searches a small Pendulum.
Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
The Pendulum Dragon for Z-ARC; searches a small Pendulum.
Wings of Light
Quick-Play: searches a Supreme King Dragon or Gate, or summons Z-ARC.
Pendulum Evolution
Trades a Pendulum for a 2500-ATK one; lets Z-ARC attack every monster.
Soul of the Supreme Celestial King
Tributes Gate Magician to Fusion Summon Z-ARC on their turn.
Soul of the Supreme King
Pays half your LP to summon Z-ARC; turns it into the four Dimension Dragons.
Miracle of the Supreme King
Swaps Z-ARC for an Odd-Eyes, or sets a Pendulum or Quick-Play Spell.
Supreme Rage
Summons up to four Supreme King Dragons alongside Z-ARC.
extra: Fusion boss: destroys every card they control when summoned; can't be targeted or destroyed by them.
Newest: becomes Z-ARC on the field; summons two Supreme King Dragons after a kill.
Level 8 Synchro: wipes their face-up monsters when Synchro Summoned.
Rank 4 from DARK Pendulums: steals ATK; returns two Pendulums in battle.
The Synchro Dragon for Z-ARC: negates a Level 5 or higher monster's effect.
The Xyz Dragon for Z-ARC: halves a monster's ATK.
The Fusion Dragon for Z-ARC: copies a big monster's effect.
Generic Synchro Dragon: negates a monster effect.
Link-3: adds a face-up Pendulum from Extra Deck to hand and Special Summons a Pendulum monster from hand or GY.
Level 7 Fusion: bounces an opponent's Attack Position monster on summon and shuffles a face-up Pendulum to negate any effect.
